body.p: JALv3 attempts to be a minimal language with most complex operations done with sub-programs, however some functions simply cannot be efficiently supported externally.

section.title: byref type predicates
section.p: The _is_*() family is built in: each predicate tests the hidden type tag of a byref formal and returns a bit. The set is _is_byte(), _is_word(), _is_dword(), _is_qword(), _is_oword(), _is_float(), their signed _is_s*() forms, the kind tests _is_string(), _is_array() and _is_pointer(), and the matching _is_*_array() / _is_*_pointer() element and pointee tests.
The full predicate table and the byref syntax are in .
